reactor_type: Savannah S100 (Ultratech/Cambridge Nanotech) with cross flow
evidence: Ultra-thin α-MoO3 films were deposited on the SiO2/Si wafers (1 kΩ cm) by ALD technique using the cross flow reactor of Savannah S100 (Ultratech/Cambridge Nanotech) with (NtBuN)2(NMe2)2Mo and oxygen plasma gases as the molybdenum precursor and oxygen precursor, respectively.
